article_content: Tragedy struck this morning as a man and woman lost their lives in a devastating collision with a lorry at motorway junction 26 in Cleckheaton, West Yorkshire. The 46-year-old man and 43-year-old woman, both residents of Bishop Auckland, Durham, were trapped in their white Audi A5 when it was overturned by a lorry. The M62 westbound has since been completely shut down, causing significant traffic disruptions across Birkenshaw, Liversedge, Heckmondwike, and beyond. The 43-year-old lorry driver, from North East Lincolnshire, was carted off to hospital with minor injuries. The police Major Collision Enquiry Team (MCET) continues its thorough investigation into the circumstances of the crash. In the meantime, the affected region remains cordoned off, hindering normal traffic flow.
